description: Spec §6.2: a fresh BP_DFCharacter wears SM_DF_Helmet on its Mesh's head socket, SM_DF_Vest on spine_03 and SM_DF_Rifle on hand_r (each visible, at world scale 1); the rifle has a Muzzle socket at world scale 1; the mannequin's slots 0 and 1 are MI_DF_Mannequin_Body and MI_DF_Mannequin_Trim; the Weapon's bDebugTrace is off and BeginPlay made the Rifle its VisualOrigin.
